sonnet.problem: The wrong answer 'To guard his own border against Aram' names Aram before card 5 asks who receives Asa's message. The other options on card 5 are Tyre and Egypt, so a baker can pick 'Ben-hadad king of Aram' from the earlier mention rather than from reasoning about the passage.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later.

sonnet.problem: 'So Asa calls up ALL the men of Judah' ties Asa's action to Baasha leaving. The text only says 'Then King Asa brought all the men of Judah' and gives no reason. The card also restates the answer card 8 just asked about ('Baasha has walked off the job').
sonnet.rule: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.
